behaviors.description: Report USB queries, generic policy and accessibility name policy.
behaviors.preconditions: Installed app and controlled USB query file.
behaviors.expected: Exact public sandbox-info USB query sets, effective policy and accessibility own value.

behaviors.description: Enforce conditional shared-memory access and report conditional expressions.
behaviors.preconditions: Installed app, controlled host /dev/shm marker and conditional permission support.
behaviors.expected: Marker unreadable by default, readable with shm:true and unreadable with shm:false; expression metadata also preserved.

behaviors.description: Report selected session and system bus policies inside the sandbox.
behaviors.expected: Public /.flatpak-info contains exact selected own/talk name policies.

behaviors.description: Report effective namespace, device and feature permission values.
behaviors.expected: Public /.flatpak-info reports exactly ipc/dri/devel without denied network/kvm/multiarch.

mappings.rationale: Exact public sandbox metadata only; no USB hardware enforcement claim. Accessibility ownership and USB list switches receive no option credit.

surface_assertions.rationale: Vendor/product query in sandbox info allow set.
Class wildcard query in sandbox info hide set.
Both generic values in effective policy set.
Previously granted value absent from effective policy set.

mappings.rationale: Controlled host shared-memory access checks device condition enforcement. Feature expression serialization receives no option credit.

surface_assertions.rationale: Host /dev/shm marker is unreadable by default, readable with shm:true, and unreadable with shm:false.

mappings.rationale: Public bus policy serialization only; this case receives no grant or ownership option credit.
Public permission serialization only; this case receives no device or feature enforcement option credit.
